mentions.name: BilingualBulletin
mentions.description: iOS app for learning a language from real news, books, and podcasts. Nearly everything runs on-device with no account required: it uses Apple's on-device translation, lets users ask questions to Apple's foundation models, and transcribes audio and video locally. Supports 19 languages, ships with built-in RSS news and podcast feeds (users can add their own), and plays audio with word-by-word follow-along. Requires iOS 26.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on BilingualBulletin, an iOS app for learning a language from real news, books and podcasts. The coolest thing about the app is that nearly everything runs on the phone, and there’s no account.
